steps.command:
perl -e '$|=1; print qq(a
b
c
); sleep 60' > /ram/out & i=0; until [ "$(wc -l < /ram/out)" -ge 3 ] || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; [ "$(wc -l < /ram/out)" -ge 3 ] && echo live; kill %1; wait %1; echo $?; cat /ram/out

perl -e '$|=1; print STDERR qq(x\ny\n); sleep 60' 2> /ram/err & i=0; until [ "$(wc -l < /ram/err)" -ge 2 ] || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; [ "$(wc -l < /ram/err)" -ge 2 ] && echo live; kill %1; wait %1; cat /ram/err

perl -e 'select(STDERR); $|=1; select(STDOUT); $|=1; print qq(o\n); print STDERR qq(e\n); sleep 60' > /ram/both 2>&1 & i=0; until [ "$(wc -l < /ram/both)" -ge 2 ] || [ $i -ge 200 ]; do i=$((i+1)); sleep 0.05; done; [ "$(wc -l < /ram/both)" -ge 2 ] && echo live; kill %1; wait %1; sort /ram/both

timeout 1 perl -e '$|=1; print qq(a
b
c
); sleep 60' > /ram/cut; echo $?; cat /ram/cut
(echo one; sleep 60) > /ram/group & sleep 1; kill %1; wait %1; cat /ram/group
